description: This file contains unit tests for the MatchRepository class in a Flutter frontend project. It uses a mock service to verify correct query parameter mapping, omission of empty fields, CSV encoding, and the behavior of the match retrieval process.

classes.name: _CapturingMockService
classes.description: A mock implementation of MatchService that captures the last query parameters used, for testing whether the repository forms correct requests.

methods.name: _CapturingMockService.fetchMatches
methods.description: Mocks fetching matches by storing the query parameters received and returning an empty list.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Contains a series of unit tests verifying the behavior of MatchRepository's fetchMatches method.
